name: Hayasaka Satsuki
source:
Satsuki is an unconfident, shy third-year high schooler afraid to fall in love (and of men to a small extent). Satsuki's negative attitude to romance was born from an event 5 years ago, during junior high school. She decided to pluck up her courage and confess her feelings to her first love and childhood friend, Kanade. However, she overhears Kanade saying to his classmate that he has no interest whatsoever in "a girl like her". To make matters worse, just before he was bound for Austria, Kanade told her that she was ugly and that she should keep her glasses on to hide her hideous face. 

In spite of her plain appearance, Satsuki has a great love for sewing and clothes. After seeing a Takarazuka (a Japanese musical where female actresses take on roles as male characters) performance, Satsuki is greatly moved by the show, and by Jun Hikari, whom acted as the male hero. Now an enthusiastic fan of Hikari, Satsuki dreams of making a costume for her. [Spoiler]After high school, Satsuki joins the costumes department of the Stella Theatre. She eventually becomes Hikari's stylist.[/Spoiler]
